transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I’m here because… people keep saying the foreclosure is just paperwork, missed payments, that kind of thing. But it’s not just that. I know the bank, the loan servicer… even some people at my job have been working together quietly to push me out of my house. It’s been going on almost two years, and showing me more papers doesn’t change what I’ve seen.
Have you had a period when you felt unusually energized and needed much less sleep than usual?
Not really. I mean, I’ve had stressful nights where I didn’t sleep much, but not like… unusually energized or anything.
Have you ever heard voices when no one else was there?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices like that.
If someone shows you clear proof that the bank is not working against you, are you able to consider that you might be mistaken?

I mean… they can show me papers, sure. But that doesn’t really change what I’ve been seeing. It’s not just paperwork. The bank and the loan servicer… and some people at my job… they’ve been working together quietly to push me out. I know that.
Have other people told you that your speech or thoughts seem hard to follow or mixed up?
I don’t think so. I mean, people get impatient with me sometimes, but no one’s said it like that.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest or motivation to do your usual activities?
I don’t know… not really. I still do what I have to do. Some days I’m just tired of dealing with everything, but I wouldn’t say I’ve lost interest.
Aside from this situation with the bank and your job, have you had any other beliefs that other people say are strange or not true?

No… not really. It’s this. The foreclosure, the bank, the loan servicer… and people at work being involved. Everyone keeps saying it’s just paperwork and payments, but that’s not what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on a long time.
During the time this has been going on, have you had a period when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I mean… I’ve been upset and stressed, yeah. But depressed most of the day every day for two weeks… I’m not sure I’d call it that.
Have there been times when your thoughts felt jumbled or hard to organize?
Not really… I mean, I get overwhelmed sometimes, but I don’t think my thoughts are jumbled. I know what I’m trying to say.
Because of all this, has your ability to work or take care of yourself clearly gotten worse?

I mean… not across the board, no. If it’s not something to do with the foreclosure, I still get up, go to work, supervise my team, do schedules, deal with customers… take care of myself.

It gets bad when the mail comes, or the bank calls, or some paperwork at work seems connected to the house. That’s when it starts interfering.
Other than your concerns about the bank and your job, have you had any experiences that others would call hallucinations, like seeing things that other people could not see?
No… I don’t think so. I haven’t seen things that weren’t there.
For how long have you been convinced that the bank and people at your job are working together to push you out of your house?
About… almost two years, I guess. Maybe a year and nine months. Since the foreclosure notices started coming and the bank calls were just… taking over everything at home.
At any time during this, have you had any other experiences that made you feel people were sending you special messages meant just for you?

Not… special messages exactly. It’s more that people keep pretending this is all just paperwork or missed payments, but I know the bank, the loan servicer, and even some people at my job have been coordinating it. Like they’re trying to force me out of my house.

They can show me papers, but that doesn’t change what I’ve been seeing.
At any time during the last two years, have you had any other unusual beliefs besides this one about the bank and your coworkers?

No… not really anything besides that. It’s the same thing I’ve been trying to explain — the bank and the loan people, and some people at work, they’ve been working together to get me out of my house. People keep saying it’s just paperwork or missed payments, but… I know what I’ve been seeing.
